recognition_features: One continuous unbranched gently winding bedding-parallel subcylindrical tube of nearly constant diameter, not an upright tube or dendritic network
Unlined smooth surface without pellets, annulation, broad lobes or pale mantle; fill differs from the host sediment
Solid uniform burrow fill directly contacts host at the illustrative cut termination, with no hollow bore or added wall sheath
concept_decisions: Concept inspected. Retain a single gentle S-shaped fill with quiet surrounding rock and homogeneous solid end. Correct any apparent carved trench/outer pale wall: fill must meet unlined host directly; no raised sheath or broad halo. Use about12mm diameter, modest half-embedded relief and two broad turns rather than tight repeated U loops. A visible end cut is illustrative, not a claimed excavated exposure. Both ends may meet slab edge, and host/trace share a seamless boundary in one closed surface with no hidden stacked slab faces. Smooth faceted tube remains readable in top and clay; do not rotate or reuse a Skolithos mesh.
